messages:
Ava: Morning! Someone put a '90s playlist in the kitchen speaker — can I add 'No Scrubs' to the queue?
Miguel: Love it. Adding 'Return of the Mack' for balance :laughing:
Kai: Quick etiquette PSA: cover your food in the microwave or we stage a soap-opera-level intervention. :face_with_raised_eyebrow:
Sophie: Also new unofficial rule: if you reheat fish, you buy brunch for a week. :fish:
Ava: Noted. I'll sacrifice a bagel to the cause.
Miguel: Tiny poll: who wants a communal sourdough starter? We can name it `Crusty Steve`.
Kai: +1 for Crusty Steve. I’ll take the watering shifts.
Sophie: -1 because I don't want bacteria cohabiting my desk. :grimacing:
Ava: +1 but only if it gets its own tiny mug.
ops-bot: Reminder: Fridge cleanout scheduled Friday 11:00 — unlabeled items go to the 'mystery pile'.
Miguel: I'll label my lunch. Promise.
Kai: Can we also have a 'jukebox queue' Google Sheet? No more DJ hijacks at 9am.
Sophie: Make the sheet columns: Song / Requester / Max repeat count — enforceable by peer pressure.
Ava: 😂 agreed. Also quick kudos to Sam for rescuing the office fern last week. :seedling: @Sam
Sam: Thanks! I did not sign up for plant parenthood but apparently I'm doing it now.
Ava: Final straw poll — 'No fish in microwave' becomes a pinned rule? React with :thumbsup: to pin.
Miguel: :thumbsup:
Kai: :thumbsup:
Sophie: :thumbsdown: (but I will comply)
Ava: OK pinned. Microwave fish ban: official. :tada:
Sophie: Optional idea — 'Bread Baking Club' meetup Tue at lunch? I can bring flour and a recipe.
Miguel: I'm in. Crusty Steve needs fans.
Ava: I'll create the sheet and drop the link here tomorrow.
ops-bot: Calendar invite created: 'Bread Baking Club — Lunch' Tue 12:00.
Ava: Thanks everyone. If anyone has a microwave fish survival tip, keep it to yourself. :wink:
